Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler refused the request because the gateway has no credentials configured for it, so nothing is scheduled and nothing has been posted.

I've checked the channels. #coastal-team and #coastal-random have the same four members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so a digest built from both can go in #coastal-team without showing anyone anything new. Once the scheduler works, I'll post the digest here every Monday at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October. It will cover the previous week's activity in both channels and open customer items. Money terms (rates, prices, contract values, invoice amounts) will be left out unless they're already posted in #coastal-team, because anything else needs approval from Anselm or June.

To get it running, someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler credentials, or I can ask the OpenClaw setup agent to look at it. Tell me which you'd like, and I'll create the schedule and run one test digest so you can see the format.
